exception: Error: types/values length mismatch (code=INVALID_ARGUMENT, ethers abi/5.6.4)
rootCause: useSingleCallResult treats inputs===undefined as valid zero-arg encode (isValidMethodArgs). When owner/projectToken missing, activeProgram was still encoded with [] → crash under Sentry Error Boundary on /liquidity/ mount.
minimalFix: Skip factory contract when activeProgramCallArgs() returns null so encode is never invoked without both addresses.
